scope: Curated extraction of the original SpringSharpMono 3.0.3032.29945 mountsCalc/gunWeightCalc readings, reconstructed through the concept two-group battery model. Each row records the native gun, mount, weight-adjustment, complete layout-armour and total long tons the new sps-3b3-battery-totals-v1 kernel must reproduce. The primary rows are the frozen source-complete coherent probe; the supplementary rows add the richer weight-adjustment selector mixes and the zero-group cases. It is not whole-program parity and not a real-ship validation.
units: canonical project values are stored as declared: calibre_mm and arm_mm are millimetres converted from the original's inches with the nominal decimal product, deck heights stay in the original's feet with a *_ft suffix, and the test converts with 0.3048 m/ft; native long tons are the original assembly's own fields
